the first group that I sang with at the Village Vanguard was a group made up of, it had Ralph Sutton on piano and Max Kaminsky on trumpet. It was Max Kaminsky's group. I think he had four pieces, the piano, trumpet, bass and drum. But off and on at the Vanguard I worked with trios and they had acts on the bill like Pete Seeger, Professor Irwin Corey. They had a magician on there who did an act with a puppet on his hand, Jerry Marshall I believe his name was. And what's his name, the comedian, Wally Cox.
